rides.title: DIRTY TUESDAY | AMAGER SOCIAL | GRAVEL BEERS N BURGERS 🍔
rides.description:
Hey all,

Join our Dirty Tuesday gravel training in and around Amager with a new weekly route.

What to expect:
Warm up, 
Hill sprints at km 3 and 11
Vo2 sprints at km 18 and 36
Open race km 46-48 (Fasanskoven)

Details:
Meet up 17:20 - Roll out 17:30
Tempo 24-25 - Distance 50km +/-
2 flats on the house (find your own way)
Remember plugs, Co2 & energy.
You must be able to ride 50k at 24k avg. 
We ride in 10-12 pax groups in same tempo.
Cancellation protocol: < 5 riders & heavy rain 

We look forward to riding dirt with you and wrap it up with beer & burgers at our favourite hangout spot - Bootleggers.

Team Dirty Tuesday

rides.title: Training Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Training Ride — a challenging group session designed to push your limits alongside dedicated cyclists. We'll ride intervals on different loops, and always regrouping afterwards to return to the city together. During transport we’ll ride as a one group, rotating turns at the front. Riders should be comfortable with group riding and familiar with standard hand and vocal signals. If you have a puncture or mechanical issue, we expect you have the route downloaded and will to rejoin the group on your own. We run a monthly rotation of efforts to vary the training. We encourage doing intervals in smaller groups when appropriate.

Week 1: 2 x 12 min at Uvelse 
Week 2: 3 x 8 min at Kettinge   
Week 3: 4 x 4 min at Bregnerød 
Week 4: Small race at Flyveren 2 laps in total ** 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!
Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 17.00
Start time: 17.15
Distance: 75-80 +/-
Pace: 32-34 km/h
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event.
#TrainingRide

rides.title: Pas Normal Studios x Salomon RunRideRelay
rides.description:
ON INVITE ONLY OR DM SIGN-UPS. 
Spots for 10 teams in total. Sign-up in pairs either 2 runners or 2 riders to ck.cph@pasnormalstudios.com 

Join us for a run and ride relay to celebrate the launch of our collaboration with Salomon. You can either join as a part of a team, or join us for cheering.

JOIN THE OPEN CHEERING ZONE, 
We encourage everyone to come and cheer to support the race. There will be music, snacks and drinks. You will be able to leave your belongings at the cheering zone. We will arrange a bus going from the store to Hørsholm.  
  
CONCEPT: 
2 runners and 2 riders makes 1 team. The runners do a 2,4k loop and then send the riders off to a 4,5k loop twice. The fastest overall time takes the win. 
Running loop: https://www.strava.com/routes/3491347760795930536 
Cycling loop:  https://www.strava.com/routes/3491347675385924520 

Teams will be paired on the day. You can let us know if you have any wishes for the team pairing.

Before sending the teams off, we will do a recon of the loops. The course is not closed to the public, so please be aware of people on the route. 

PRACTICAL INFORMATION: 
Meet-up at the store (Århusgade 126): 16.00 
Event start at Hørsholm, Folehaven: 17.15 
Small snacks and drinks will be provided at the cheering zone at Hørsholm. 

A bus will take the runners to the spot at 16.15 and everyone else who wants to come and cheer. Everyone joining on bike, will ride together up there.  

If you have any questions, please reach out to ck.cph@pasnormalstudios.com

rides.title: Social Ride - Gravel 90 km | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
🚴‍♂️ Nordic Chase: Gravel Social Ride (90 km)
Join us for a Social Ride in the spirit of the legendary Nordic Chase! We’re heading out to tackle the first 40 km of the official Copenhagen-to-Oslo Gravel Edition route, then looping back for a well-deserved caffeine fix.

This is a social ride, but we’ll be moving at a steady pace to keep things spicy. Expect a morning of prime gravel, good company, and great coffee.

📍 The Details
- GRAVEL RIDE
- Meetup: 08:25 AM
- Roll-out: 08:30 AM Sharp ⏱️
- Start Point: GoNordic Cruiseline HQ (Official Race Start)
- Distance: ~90 km
- Pace: 27–28 km/h (approx. 3.5 hours of riding)
- Finish: ~12:30 PM at Kliché Værksted (Islands Brygge) for coffee and food.

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Group Size: Limited to 20 riders. We will split into smaller groups on the road to ensure safety.

Please bring:
- Enough water and snacks to fuel 3 hours of effort.
- A flat kit in case of punctures.

⚠️ Note: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit.

Ready to chase? Hit 'Going' to secure your spot—first come, first served!

rides.title: Hybrid Social Ride x Original Coffee (Pace 26-28)
Hybrid Social+ Ride x Original Coffee (Pace 27-29)
DIRTY SUNDAY
rides.description:
Dirty Sunday – Gravel in Northern Zealand
Distance: 80 or 130 km - (Early Bird until 15.01.2026)

Dirty Sunday offers the perfect gravel route in Northern Zealand, featuring wide gravel roads, deep woodland sections, and rolling farm tracks. We welcome all riders — from the fast boys and girls chasing the front to those here to enjoy the scenery and maybe spend a little extra time at the midway shooting range for a chance to win one of the day’s prizes.

We once again invite you to a full-scale gravel celebration. Starting from Teglovnen Nordsjælland, we have everything we need to create a true festival atmosphere around one of Zealand’s biggest gravel events.

We’ve put a lot of effort into designing a safe and well-marked route with route marshals at key points, traffic officials, and barriers where needed.

Professional photographers will be on course to capture the energy before, during, and after the race.

Before the race: Free coffee for everyone.

After the race: Food from the grill, beer from a Danish brewery, ice cream, and all the cake and coffee you can consume.

🥃🎯 Whiskey & Gun Range Gravel
At km 90, you get the chance to take home the biggest prizes of the day.
Hit the bullseye and grab a whiskey shot on your way back to the finish 🤠

Read more about the race here: https://www.sportstiming.dk/event/17257

This ride is all about the ice breaker. Use these miles to meet the riders you’ll be chasing (and drafting) over the next few days. It’s also the perfect time for a final equipment test—better to catch a rattling bag or a gear tweak today than tomorrow morning!

📍 The Details

Meetup: 3:30 PM

Roll-out: 3:30 PM Sharp ⏱️

Start Point: Standert Bicycles (Official Race Start)

Distance: ~43 km (Social shake out)

Pace: 27–28 km/h

Finish: Back at Standert for the Rider Briefing & Pasta Party 🍝

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Groups: We will split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.

Navigation: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️

Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures and your best post-taper vibes.

The Pasta Party 🍝
We’ll finish up back at the shop for the official briefing and a pasta feed to fuel the journey ahead.

Sign Up:
If you’re not officially on the roster for the race to Copenhagen yet, head to:

👉 www.nordicchase.com

See you at the shop! ✌️

rides.title: Copenhagen Cycling Club Road Saturday
rides.description:
Lørdag den 6. juni køres der en ny landevejsrute fra Copenhagen Cycling Club. 

Vi skal op nordpå mod Tikøb, hvor der køres lidt opvarmning undervejs. Når vi drejer vestover køres der på et udvalg af lækre landeveje inden vi gør stop i Vejby, hvor der kan hældes benzin på dunken. 

Tempoet vil variere efter om der køres intervaller eller transport, men forvent en hård dag til bentøjet. Husk masser af sukker i dunken, downloadet rute, og plugs, slange, Co2 og den slags. 

Vi mødes ved butikken kl. 09.15 til de morgenfriske! Afgang 9.30 :)
